item.title: Wakayama Onsen Guide: Mountain Hot Springs & Pacific Coast Ryokan
item.description: Wakayama Prefecture contains one of Japan’s highest concentrations of historically significant hot springs — not a coincidence, given that the entire Kii Peninsula sits above the tectonic boundary where the Philippine Sea Plate subducts beneath Honshu, heating groundwater through volcanic activity across a large area. Three of the prefecture’s onsen towns sit directly on the Kumano Kodo pilgrimage network and were healing destinations for emperors, monks, and exhausted pilgrims long before modern tourism existed.
